question: Which local frequency/parallel-index combinations are worth supplying to an established ray and current-drive calculation for the published fixed-radius alternative, and do they satisfy the local cold-wave dispersion prerequisite?
prior_work: Poli et al. (2018) HARE and Lopez, Alieva, McNamara, Zhang (2025 publication; arXiv v2 2026) feed-forward launcher selection. Apply their local analytic formulas, not a new method and not a reproduction of their GENRAY results.

fixed_execution.note: Sensitivity values are selected before evaluation; not probabilities or physical uncertainty bounds. The full grid has56 local evaluations, not56 ray/transport runs.

methods: Reconstruct analytic profiles and check their volume averages
HARE analytic resonant-electron and wave seed selection
Electron-only Stix cold-plasma dispersion roots at the target
Local required efficiency normalization, without assigning any achieved efficiency
fail_criteria: No positive continuous cold O-like perpendicular-index root at target
Failure of independently recomputed resonance or Maxwell determinant identity
excluded_claims: actual launcher coordinates or physical rays
measured or predicted achieved current drive
access_scope: Workstation calls explicitly paused by its monthly-usage limit; do not retry/reconnect. Current GitHub tools are read-only. This computation uses the local ChatGPT container and public read data only; no credentials or restrictions are bypassed.
stop_rule: Retain all56 seeds and all rejection reasons. Package the source, tests, scientific report and offline visualization. No brute-force launch scan, optimizer retuning or synthetic efficiency reward.
